# .github Folder README

This file explains only the `.github` folder.

The full project is `KiCad Engine`, and the actual repo purpose is described in the root [README.md](../README.md).

Do not mistake this folder for the whole project. `.github` is only the GitHub collaboration and automation layer around KiCad Engine.

Start with:

- [../README.md](../README.md)
- [../START_HERE.md](../START_HERE.md)
- [../CURRENT_STATUS.md](../CURRENT_STATUS.md)
- [../PROJECTS_INDEX.md](../PROJECTS_INDEX.md)
- [../WORKFLOWS_INDEX.md](../WORKFLOWS_INDEX.md)
- [../TOOLS_INDEX.md](../TOOLS_INDEX.md)

## What This Folder Is For

- issue templates
- pull request templates
- GitHub Actions workflows
- CODEOWNERS
- branch-protection guidance
- GitHub-facing repo automation metadata

## What This Folder Is Not

- not the main project documentation
- not the identity of the whole repo
- not a KiCad project workspace
- not the place for schematic, PCB, or manufacturing source files

For the actual KiCad Engine purpose and workflow, always go back to the root [README.md](../README.md).
